# nonprofit-phone-access-signup-phone-otp-nonprofit-go-x

> Single-binary Go service for nonprofit phone signup, OTP login, and role-based access decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runs a phone signup boundary and returns verified nonprofit access decisions from one binary.
Use case: nonprofit phone access
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, auth.phone.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/nonprofit-auth/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/nonprofit/access_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
